Which events an endpoint receives is controlled per endpoint by `agent_id` (scope) and `events` (allowlist); with both omitted the endpoint is account-wide and receives every event type. post.summary: Send a test event to a webhook endpoint
post.description: Enqueues a real, signed `webhook.test` delivery to this one endpoint through the production queue, so it exercises signing, SSRF validation, and retries, and appears in delivery history like any other event. The endpoint's `events` allowlist is deliberately bypassed — a test must reach the endpoint being tested even when its filter would exclude everything — so `webhook.test` is not a valid allowlist value and must be handled or ignored explicitly in your handler. Disabled endpoints are refused.

patch.summary: Toggle account-wide fan-out for an agent
patch.description:
Controls whether this agent's events also reach your account-wide endpoints. `true` (the default) is additive: the agent's events go to its own endpoints **and** every account-wide endpoint. `false` routes them to the agent's own endpoints only.

Filtering is strict when fan-out is off: an event whose type is not in any of the agent's endpoint allowlists is dropped, not forwarded to an account-wide endpoint as a fallback.

Turning it off is refused while the agent has no enabled endpoint of its own, and it flips back to `true` automatically if you later delete or disable the agent's last enabled endpoint — an agent is never left with nowhere to deliver.

include_account_endpoints.description: Whether this agent's events also reach account-wide endpoints.

put.description: Stores VoiceLink credentials for outbound calling. VoiceLink authenticates with a panel `username` and `password`; Vocobase logs in with these to obtain a short-lived access token (the password is stored encrypted and never returned). `username`, `password`, and `from_number` are required. `base_url` is accepted for backwards compatibility but ignored: VoiceLink only accepts connections from Indian IP addresses, so Vocobase routes all outbound VoiceLink traffic through its own India-based egress and sets the host itself. It is returned as an origin only. The `from_number` must be an E.164 number provisioned on your VoiceLink account and is stored as the connection's default outbound DID. Requires `"voicelink"` in `allowed_telephony_providers`.

password.description: VoiceLink panel password. Stored encrypted; never returned.

from_number.description: VoiceLink-provisioned number used as the caller ID, in E.164 format. Stored as the connection's default DID.

base_url.description: Optional VoiceLink API base URL. Omit to use the default host.

put.summary: Set or update Tata Smartflo credentials

The `from_number` must be an E.164 DID returned by Smartflo `GET /v1/my_number` and is stored as the connection's default outbound DID. Requires `"tata_smartflo"` in `allowed_telephony_providers`.

password.description: Tata Smartflo panel password. Stored encrypted; never returned.

from_number.description: Tata Smartflo DID used as the caller ID, in E.164 format. Stored as the connection's default DID.

intro_message.description: Optional greeting spoken when a call connects.

screener_handling_enabled.description: Per-agent toggle for phone screener handling on outbound calls. Requires `voicemail_detection_enabled` to be true and platform screener handling to be enabled.

voicemail_message.description: Optional message used after a supported carrier detects voicemail. Pass `null` or an empty string to clear.

enable_recording.description: Whether to record calls made with this agent.

kb_llm_system_prompt.description: System prompt for LLM KB processing.

end_call_enabled.description: Master toggle for the end-call tool. When false, the agent cannot end calls on its own regardless of `end_call_instructions`.

end_call_message.description: Farewell line spoken before the bot hangs up. When null/empty, a platform default is used.

end_call_instructions.description: Free-text natural-language instructions spliced into the system prompt under "When to end the call." Write your own conditions in plain English, e.g. "End the call when the caller says goodbye, has not spoken for an extended period, or asks to be removed from the list." When null/empty, the section is skipped entirely. Replaces the prior `end_call_triggers` enum array.

transfer_enabled.description: Master toggle for cold-transfer-to-human. `transfer_number` is required when true. When the agent transfers a call, Vocobase connects the caller to `transfer_number`. The session.completed webhook includes transfer metadata — see `data.call.transferred`.

transfer_number.description: E.164 number to transfer the call to. Required when `transfer_enabled` is true.

transfer_message.description: Announcement spoken before the transfer. When null/empty, a platform default is used.

transfer_instructions.description: Free-text natural-language instructions spliced into the system prompt under "When to transfer." Write your own conditions in plain English. When null/empty, the section is skipped. Replaces the prior `transfer_triggers` enum array.

user_idle_enabled.description: Controls whether the agent responds to caller silence using platform-managed idle settings. Defaults to true. When false, the bot will not ask if the caller is still there and will not end the call because of idle silence. Timeout and retry values are not configurable through V2.

tool_ack_config.description: Per-agent spoken acknowledgement while a tool call (e.g. `search_knowledge_base`) runs. New agents default to enabled with `mode` set to `dynamic` when this field is omitted. Pass `null` to opt the new agent out, or an object to customize.

extraction_enabled.description: Master switch for automatic post-call extraction. Defaults to true. When false, extraction is skipped after calls even if an `extraction_config` is later set (the config is preserved). The extraction schema itself is set via PUT /agent/{id} (`extraction_config`).

max_call_duration_secs.description: Hard cap on call duration in seconds. New agents default to 600 (10 minutes); pass `null` to disable the cap. Range 60-3600. At `(cap - 30s)` the bot speaks a soft "wrapping up" warning; at the cap it speaks the agent's farewell and gracefully ends the session through the standard end-of-call path.

background_audio_id.description: Reference to a `BackgroundAudio` asset (see `GET /agent/background-audio`) the bot will mix under its TTS for the duration of the call.

background_audio_volume.description: Mixing volume for `background_audio_id`. Range 0.0-1.0. When `null`, the bot applies a default of 0.3.

post.description: Initiates an outbound phone call via MCube, Twilio, Exotel, Plivo, Vobiz, Tata Smartflo, SIP, or VoiceLink. Requires sufficient credits and available call concurrency; use `GET /calls/concurrency` to inspect current capacity before starting a call. The provider you pass must appear in the account's `allowed_telephony_providers` list and its credentials must already be configured. For non-MCube providers, pass `connection_id` when the account has multiple active connections for the same provider. Provider-only calls remain backward compatible when exactly one active connection exists for that provider. Pass `from_number` to choose the caller ID for this call: it must be an active phone number owned on the selected connection (it overrides the agent-bound or default number for Twilio, Plivo, Vobiz, Tata Smartflo, VoiceLink, and SIP; MCube and Exotel caller IDs are fixed, so a differing `from_number` returns 400). When omitted, the caller ID is the agent-bound number where supported, otherwise the connection default. The resolved caller ID is returned as `from_number` in the response. The call is placed asynchronously. Use `call.status.updated` webhooks or `GET /calls/{id}` to track live status, and use `session.completed` for final transcript, recording, billing, variables, and extraction data.

Must be an ACTIVE phone number owned on the selected connection (`connection_id` picks the connection; `from_number` picks the number within it) -- an unknown number returns 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, never a silent substitution. Overrides the agent-bound/default number for Twilio, Plivo, Vobiz, VoiceLink, and SIP. MCube and Exotel use a fixed caller ID, so any differing value returns 400. post.description:
Promotes an agent's inline extraction keys into a reusable set, attaches the set to that agent, and clears the moved keys from the agent's inline config — so each key still reaches the agent exactly once.

SessionCompletedWebhook.description: Outbound webhook sent after the Vocobase session and post-call pipeline have completed. Use this event for transcript, recording, billing, variables, and extraction data.

allowed_voices.description: Voice IDs available to this account.

allowed_languages.description: Language codes available to this account.

allowed_telephony_providers.description: Providers this account is allowed to use when starting calls. Managed by Vocobase platform admins.

webhooks.description: Configured webhook endpoints. Endpoint secrets are never returned by config reads.

source.description: Where the active MCube credentials come from. New integrations should use telephony connections.

spoken_languages.description: Up to 2 languages the agent speaks. At most one regional/Hindi language; hinglish only pairs with en or hi. Empty/omitted = default (voice language). Valid: ["en","hi"], ["en","hinglish"], ["hi","hinglish"], ["en","te"]. Invalid: ["mr","te"], ["te","hi"], ["mr","hi"].

voicemail_detection_enabled.description: Whether carrier-side voicemail detection is enabled for this agent on supported outbound providers.

screener_handling_enabled.description: Whether phone screener handling is enabled for this agent on outbound calls.

voicemail_message.description: Message used after a supported carrier detects voicemail. Max 500 characters.

variables.description: Pre-call variable names referenced in the prompt or greeting as `{{name}}`. Empty array when none are defined.

extraction_config.description: Custom Analysis config — when present AND `extraction_enabled` is true, the platform runs an LLM extraction over each completed call's transcript and ships the result inline in the `session.completed` webhook.

tool_ack_config.description: Per-agent tool-call acknowledgement configuration, or `null` when the feature is off. See the ToolAckConfig schema.

extraction_enabled.description: Master switch for automatic post-call extraction. When false, extraction is skipped after calls even if `extraction_config` is set (the config is preserved). Manual replay via `POST /calls/{call_id}/extract` still works.

project_id.description: ID of the project this agent belongs to. Defaults to the default project if not specified.

transfer_enabled.description: Enable call transfer to a human agent.

transfer_number.description: E.164 phone number to transfer calls to. Required when `transfer_enabled` is true.

transfer_message.description: Announcement spoken before transferring. Max 500 characters.

transfer_instructions.description: Free-text natural-language instructions spliced into the system prompt under "When to transfer." Max 2000 characters. Replaces the prior `transferTriggers` enum array.

end_call_enabled.description: Enable the agent to end calls on its own.

end_call_message.description: Farewell message spoken before hanging up. Max 500 characters.

end_call_instructions.description: Free-text natural-language instructions spliced into the system prompt under "When to end the call." Max 2000 characters. Replaces the prior `endCallTriggers` enum array.

user_idle_enabled.description: Whether the agent responds to caller silence using platform-managed idle settings. When false, the bot will not ask if the caller is still there and will not end the call due to idle silence.

max_call_duration_secs.description: Hard cap on call duration in seconds. New agents default to 600 (10 minutes). Set to `null` to disable the cap. Range 60-3600. At `(cap - 30s)` the agent speaks a soft "wrapping up" warning; at the cap it speaks the agent's `end_call_message` (or a default farewell) and gracefully ends the session through the standard end-of-call path so transcript, recording, billing and the `session.completed` webhook all fire normally.

background_audio_id.description: Reference to a `BackgroundAudio` asset (from `GET /agent/background-audio`) that the bot mixes under its TTS for the duration of the call. `null` (default) means no background audio. The asset must be visible to the account — either a platform-curated asset (`is_platform: true`) or one the account uploaded.

background_audio_volume.description: Mixing volume for `background_audio_id`. Range 0.0-1.0. When `null`, the bot applies a default of 0.3.

BackgroundAudioOption.description: A background-audio asset visible to the account — either platform-curated (`is_platform: true`) or one the account uploaded (`owner_user_id` matches their account).

slug.description: Stable identifier; unique across all assets.

owner_user_id.description: Null for platform assets; the owning user id otherwise.

duration_secs.description: Detected from WAV header at upload time.

VoiceTier.description: A public Vocobase voice model tier.

Voice.description: A voice from the platform catalog. Pass `id` as `voice_id` on agent create/update.

id.description: Pass this as `voice_id` on agent create/update.

tier.description: Drives the per-minute rate at billing time.

provider_voice_id.description: Provider-native voice id or voice name. Use `id`, not this field, when creating agents or previewing audio.

preview_text.description: Default text used by the preview endpoint when no `text` query parameter is provided.

metadata.description: Provider-specific metadata for the voice configuration.

file_size.description: File size in bytes (null for web links).

sync_status.description: Whether this document has been indexed into the agent's knowledge base.

disposition.description: Final call outcome derived from carrier signals and bot-side signals. Use `voicemail` to detect carrier or bot voicemail outcomes.

answered_by.description: Best-known answer classification. `machine` indicates an answering machine or voicemail.

hangup_cause.description: Raw normalized carrier hangup cause when available.

hangup_source.description: Best-known party or system that ended the call.

bill_duration_seconds.description: Carrier-billed duration in seconds when available.

connection_id.description: Telephony connection used for the call, when applicable.

processing_complete.description: `true` when the post-call pipeline has finished. See `Session.processing_complete` on the polling endpoint for the full semantics.

pipeline_completed_at.description: Timestamp when the pipeline finished. Non-null on the webhook payload itself.

recording_url.description: Presigned URL to download the call recording (audio/wav). Valid for 7 days from the time of this response. Use `GET /calls/{id}/recording-url` to mint a fresh URL after expiry. `null` if recording was not enabled or the call has not completed.

variables.description: Pre-call variable values resolved at session-start, substituted into the agent's prompt and greeting via `{{name}}`. Empty object when no variables were supplied.

extraction.description: Post-call extraction result. `null` until extraction runs after the call ends. Always `null` when the agent has no `extraction_config`.

ToolAckConfig.description: Per-agent spoken acknowledgement played when the agent starts an eligible tool call, to mask tool latency such as a knowledge-base lookup. Never fires for `end_call` or `transfer_call`. The object is forwarded to the voice engine as-is, so nested keys are camelCase.

enabled.description: Turn the spoken acknowledgement on or off.

mode.description: `static` speaks a random built-in phrase (no added latency). `dynamic` has the LLM generate a short, context- and language-aware line each time (adds roughly 300-800 ms and one extra inference per tool call).

maxWords.description: Dynamic mode only: soft word cap on the generated acknowledgement. Defaults to 10.

ExtractionConfig.description: Custom Analysis schema — defines what the post-call extraction LLM should pull from each completed call's transcript.

prompt.description: Free-form analysis prompt. Describe the data you want extracted; reference the keys by name.

includeToolLogs.description: When true, the extraction LLM also sees the agent's tool calls + KB hits, not just the transcript. Useful for catching things like 'did the agent search for X' or 'what was the booking outcome'.

ExtractionResult.description: Structured output of a single extraction run. Shipped inline in `session.completed` webhooks AND returned by `POST /calls/{id}/extract`.

values.description: Extracted fields, typed per the agent's `extraction_config.keys`. Missing keys are emitted as `null` (per-key `nullable: true` on the response schema). Absent entirely when `status != 'success'`.

model.description: Opaque extraction model identifier. Do not branch business logic on this value.

attempts.description: Number of attempts (1 = success on first try; 2-3 = retried).

term_count.description: Number of unique terms after normalization.

attached_agent_count.description: Number of agents this dictionary is currently attached to.

terms.description: Normalized list of terms (whitespace-trimmed, case-insensitively deduped, non-string entries dropped).
